_comment: Edit these values to match your setup before running.
_cda_note: Drag coefficient × frontal area (m²). Typical values: 0.40 upright, 0.32 hoods, 0.25 aero/TT.
_cr_note: Typical values: 0.003 racing slicks, 0.004 road tyres, 0.008 gravel.
_wheel_note: 700c × 25mm ≈ 2.096 m. Measure your own or use an online calculator.
